items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: He had a band. And he had a... He had a fellow... Two men once played with my big band with him at the time. He had Eugene Porter. And he had Earl Bostic.

ctx.x: And at that time they had... Cycloform player. He was very... He was very famous at the time because he... He wrote... Chan of the Weeds.
